editorial:
Imagine living in a tiny, quiet town where absolutely nothing ever happens. That is exactly how Filip feels. He spends his days as a librarian in Samobor, just longing for the excitement of the big city. You will feel his boredom right along with him until Elza, the new manager, walks into the library. She is beautiful and brings a spark of life into his dull world. But just as things start to get interesting, the town takes a dark turn. People start dying in weird ways, and the cozy feeling of the town turns into something much more suspicious and creepy.

What really works here is how the movie builds tension without rushing. The acting is natural and makes you wonder who is actually lying. While the pace is a bit slow at first, the mystery keeps you guessing. If you like stories where a normal life turns into a nightmare, you will love this.
endingExplained: You find out that Filip is not as innocent as he seems. His obsession with death and funerals leads him to commit the crimes. The twist is that his longing for excitement turned into a dark urge to control life and death. In the end, his secrets come out, and the dream of a new life with Elza falls apart. He is finally caught, showing that his boredom led him down a dangerous path.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quiet mysteries and psychological twists.
